description:
DONE in two landings. The deploy-gate half is recorded in specs/1401-deploy-gate-can-fail/spec.md. The doc-audit half is recorded in specs/1401-deploy-gate-can-fail/doc-audit.md.

DOC-AUDIT OUTCOME. Stash-B was already applied, not drifted: its forward apply failed because the text was in the tree. The rebase was moot. The refuter pass ran over the text it left: docs/ci-gotchas.md, docs/runbooks/terraform-state.md, and the CLEANUP-BOARD card it added were corrected. Both stash patches are deleted. Deferred items: SECURITY.md is rewritten to the controls that exist, after it was found claiming four controls FIXED that do not run. docs/diagrams/TEMPLATE.md and infrastructure/terraform/bootstrap/README.md are corrected. injected-docs-check.sh is fixed, moved to scripts/injected-docs/, runnable as `make check-injected-docs`, and recommended BLOCKING. That wiring awaits the operator through the NEW card this branch raises.

OPERATOR ACTIONS STILL OWED, not code. TIINGO_API_KEY and FINNHUB_API_KEY do not exist as repository secrets. Until they do, the 22 @external-api tests run in zero CI contexts.

CARRY FORWARD, measured. Anchoring the accessible name does NOT disambiguate AAPL from AAPLW. The option name computes as 'AAPLApple Inc.' (ticker-input.tsx:215-217, adjacent spans with no whitespace node), so match rows by id="ticker-option-<symbol>".

CONTEXT. deploy-prod, build-sse-image-prod and build-dashboard-image-prod are `if: false` in deploy.yml ('TEMP: Skip production'). The preprod gate's consequences stop at preprod until prod is re-enabled.
